decisions.sourceGeometry: One original complete valid explicitly closed red vector ring; no repair, joining, rounding, snapping, buffering, clipping or simplification applied to export.
decisions.manualIdentityQualification: The page title and interior Baghdadi label uniquely identify the complete target ring. Its northern stepped red divider separately labels Bekalta South and East. Its western edge follows the blue Moknine lagoon boundary, its eastern edge follows the black coast boundary, and its full southern black governorate boundary separates Monastir/Bekalta from Mahdia/Hiboun. The ring includes the complete southern boundary inside both clips; no neighboring target or clipped continuation is joined.

inventory.method: All 2084 raw sector identities checked, with 25 accepted substitutes plus the pending Bekalta aggregate, Fadhalin, Ayaicha, South, East and Baghdadi. Every positive raw or rounded intersection retained without threshold. Unrelated recently excluded source sectors are far outside this cluster; raw identity count is an audit denominator, not the current app count.

limits: Exports preserve the original complete rings at source precision. App coordinate quantization is evaluated separately and remains an ordinary precision limit.
No claim of survey accuracy or exact abutting boundaries between independently georeferenced maps.
Remaining unreviewed-neighbor overlaps stay explicit; source geometry acceptance does not certify the entire cluster.

completeBekaltaIdentitySet.scopeEvidence: Decree590 annex1 tableA PDFp15 explicitly lists South, East, Baghdadi as whole-imada circles and North1+2 as exhaustive parts of one North imada.

completeBekaltaClusterTopology.gapMethod: Exact unions used only for diagnostic inventory. Every enclosed interior ring is recorded without size threshold; no gap is filled and no individual candidate boundary changes. These counts are not proof against open-edge survey discrepancies or unmapped neighborhood coverage.
completeBekaltaClusterTopology.gapWidthQualification: The area-to-half-perimeter ratio summarizes thinness; it is not a maximum gap width or survey tolerance.

remainingExternalIssue.conclusion: The official Baghdadi southern black boundary identifies the governorate border, but the old Hiboun source intrudes north of it. A complete independent Hiboun map is required before claiming the mixed-source external boundary is coherent; Baghdadi geometry must not be clipped to the old Hiboun shape.
